memory: I see that Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer from Seattle who is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been exploring both standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines from our company. He specifically wants an espresso machine with a stainless-steel finish and a steam wand for frothing milk. He has a budget in mind and is considering a specific model with a steam wand. He also mentioned having a small kitchen counter, which might require some counter rearrangement to accommodate the machine. I should check the order status and provide an update to Michael regarding the delivery.
